channel_decomposition.mirror_rule: l1 is the k<->l image of k1 in the symmetric Q-row gauge
channel_decomposition.policy: Keep shift-channel labels through the correction-flux construction; recombine before the final n-holonomic elimination.

shell_stratification.reason: The exact protected lattice convention replaces only B_k/B_l moving-support reciprocals by pinv_r(x)=x^-r for x>0 and 0 for x<=0. Feeding pinv directly to ordinary rational holonomic machinery would erase this discrete shell semantics.
shell_stratification.interior_piece: On strata where every active protected argument is positive, replace pinv_r(x) by the ordinary rational x^-r and use rational/hypergeometric correction algebra.
shell_stratification.shell_piece: Retain the finitely many moving top-row/top-column strata on which one or more protected arguments are nonpositive as separate finite-support contributions.
shell_stratification.mirror_reduction: k-shell and l-shell strata are exchanged by the exact k<->l symmetry.

letter_decomposition.rationale: Within each interior or shell stratum, ordinary harmonic finite differences reduce to rational forcing; the block split is used to build correction certificates, not to demand separate recurrences.

certificate_architecture.base: Use the independently replayed 122-row pole-free coefficient layer and the reverified regularized Q-row F/J scalar basis.
certificate_architecture.step_1: Stratify the eight protected positive reciprocals into an interior rational piece and finitely-supported moving-shell pieces, preserving exact k<->l mirror data.
certificate_architecture.step_2: For each symmetry-reduced shift channel and harmonic weight block, construct the coefficientwise rational/hypergeometric correction-flux system; test bounded support/rank viability before any expensive elimination.
certificate_architecture.step_3: Reconstruct any positive correction candidate exactly and substitute it into the complete coefficient layer, including shell strata and regularized finite-box boundary terms.
certificate_architecture.step_4: Recombine all channel, letter-block, and shell pieces before seeking the final n-holonomic operator.
certificate_architecture.step_5: Independently replay the assembled certificate and recurrence propagation obligations before any theorem promotion.

anti_oversplitting_rule: Do not require each letter, shift channel, or shell stratum to possess its own low-order n-recurrence. Splitting is a certificate-construction device; the low-order operator may exist only after exact recombination.
